capabilities.summary: Scan an explicitly selected local source tree with bundled Semgrep static-analysis and secret-pattern rules without uploading code or modifying findings.
useWhen: A local project needs a read-only baseline scan for bundled vulnerability and secret patterns.
The caller accepts that a clean result covers only the bundled local rules.
doNotUseWhen: Remote Semgrep Registry rules, Semgrep Cloud, login, upload, or network access are required.
The requested outcome includes automatic remediation or source-file writes.
Semgrep is not already installed and executable.
permissions: Read the selected local scan target.
Execute an already-installed local Semgrep binary.

capabilities.summary: Preview an installation, upgrade, or rollback of the Skill projection at an explicitly selected project or user scope without writing files.
useWhen: The caller wants to inspect the exact target and action before authorizing an installation or rollback.
doNotUseWhen: The target contains unknown, modified, linked, or unreceipted content.
The caller expects the preview to write files, install Semgrep, download rules, or overwrite the legacy code-security directory.
permissions: Read the component source and the selected installation target.

capabilities.summary: Install or upgrade the Skill projection at an explicitly selected project or user scope after approval; this does not install Semgrep.
useWhen: The caller approved applying a previously previewed project-scoped or user-scoped semgrep-skill installation.
doNotUseWhen: The target contains unknown, modified, linked, or unreceipted content.
The caller has not approved the write or expects Semgrep, remote rules, or the legacy code-security directory to be changed.
permissions: Read the component source and selected installation target.
Write only the selected semgrep-skill target and installer-owned backup directory.
sideEffects: Creates or replaces the selected Skill projection and writes a receipt.
On upgrade, retains the verified previous installation for rollback.

when: Before passing --apply for a project installation or upgrade.
Before passing --apply at user scope, which affects all projects for that user.

capabilities.summary: Restore the receipted previous Skill projection after explicit approval while preserving the displaced current version.
useWhen: A validated previous installation exists and the caller approved restoring it.
doNotUseWhen: The current or previous installation is missing, modified, linked, unknown, or unreceipted.
The caller has not approved replacing the current projection.
permissions: Read the current and receipted previous installation.
Replace only the selected semgrep-skill target and installer-owned backup entries.
sideEffects: Restores the previous projection and retains the displaced current projection as a backup.

when: Before passing --rollback with --apply at project or user scope.
